beats.narration_text: Let's recap with Claude. Twenty techniques, one SVG mark, zero keyframes. Every move you watched is a pure function of the frame number: spring configs carry the weight, interpolate plus easing carries every glide, and the reveals are nothing but masks, slices, and stroke-dashoffset. The mark never changed. Only the math around it did.

Your turn. Here's the prompt, word for word: take my logo SVG and build a Remotion showcase that runs it through every entrance, emphasis, and exit technique you know — one labeled technique per beat — then flag the three moves that fit my brand's weight. That last clause is the real work: twenty moves is a catalog, three is a decision. Run it, and watch which springs Claude picks for you.
One logo mark, every move Remotion knows. Liam, in for Bear.
